# Study Time Statistics 2.0.0

## English

2.0 introduces the Study Cockpit as the default dashboard home. It combines today and weekly reading, goal progress, week-over-week change, median session length, deep-reading share, verified-study share, the highest-investment hour, and a conservative revisit queue. Revisit suggestions mean only “not opened recently”; they never claim forgetting or mastery.

Charts remain compact and aligned to the newest data. All processing stays local.

## 中文

2.0 新增默认打开的“学习驾驶舱”，集中展示今日与本周阅读、目标进度、周环比、会话中位时长、深度阅读占比、已确认学习占比、高投入时段和保守的建议回看队列。建议回看只表示“最近没有打开”，绝不推断遗忘或掌握程度。

图表继续保持紧凑并默认对齐最新数据，全部处理仍在本地完成。
